name: Hotel Jägerhof
beschreibung: The family-managed Hotel Jägerhof is situated on a peaceful sunny high plateau in Kolsassberg above the Inn Valley. Its elevated vantage point provides breathtaking panoramic vistas across the limestone crests of the Karwendel Alps. Emphasizing traditional Tyrolean woodwork and genuine warmth, the hotel offers comfortable accommodations and charming wood-panelled lounges. A modern indoor wellness area with an indoor pool, Finnish sauna, and steam bath promises complete rest after outdoor adventures. Guests on half-board enjoy wholesome buffet breakfasts and multi-course regional dinners. Hiking trails depart directly from the door, with the Kellerjoch and Glungezer ski slopes just a short drive away.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy alpine panorama hotel in Kolsassberg featuring an indoor pool, spa area, and Karwendel views.
